phase.description: Provide fast, privacy-safe offline replay of accepted gatekeeper contracts for reliable governed testing without provider spend.
acceptanceCriteria: Replay completes in 2 seconds or less on the recorded reference environment with zero provider spend.
Fixtures contain only minimum redacted and normalised contract data needed for replay, including coverage derived from the four committed B9 decision records and synthetic adversarial cases.
Replay neither requires nor exposes credentials, secrets, raw provider prompts, or unnecessary full provider responses.
The configured project test suites run and the mechanically binding validator validate-no-secrets passes.
Paid gatekeeper dispatch remains subject to mandatory Doctor preflight and existing owner gates.
requiredReviews: Security/privacy review of fixture derivation and redaction
requiredOwnerGates: No production deployment, database mutation, messaging, payment, credential creation or disclosure, force push, or merge.
Any paid gatekeeper dispatch remains owner-gated and requires mandatory Doctor preflight.
